title: beam_bands records (JSONL log and cable data-track kind 4)
description: One record per second of CONTIGUOUS, aligned 8-beam audio, produced by pc/bma_cable_sink.py (BandMeter). The same compact JSON line (separators , and :) is the payload of data-track frame kind 4 AND one line of the beam_bands.jsonl log (default <data-dir>/reports/beam_bands.jsonl, rotated to .1 at 256 MB, metadata only, no audio). Values are mean-square level in dB re full scale per beam and octave band: a sine of amplitude A reads 20*log10(A/sqrt(2)) dB in its band (full scale reads -3.0), silence reads -200.0. The record carries its own major version in `v`.

v.description: Record format major version. A reader MUST skip records with a v it does not know.

idx.description: Card sample index (the BMAA `block` space, u32) of the first sample of the window.

t_us.description: PC UTC microseconds when the record was produced, i.e. when the window's last sample had arrived: the window started about n/48000 s earlier.

n.description: Window length in samples (1 s at 48 kHz).

zero_frac.description: Fraction of the window's rows in which all 8 beams are exactly zero (lost audio filled with silence).

edges_hz.description: The 8 octave bands [lo, hi) in Hz; a bin belongs to a band when lo <= f < hi.

db.description: db[beam][band]: beam 0-7 = beams 1-8 (bridge slots 0-7), band index into edges_hz; one decimal; -200.0 = no energy.
